title: New option for QML TasksModel: "filterTransients"
line: Widgets that list windows can now include dialogs and other transient windows by setting filterTransients: false on their TasksModel.
explanation: WaylandTasksModel reports every transient window (one with a parent window, such as a dialog) as SkipTaskbar, and TasksModel always filters SkipTaskbar tasks with no way to turn that off from QML, so third-party applets like Window Buttons could never reach dialogs. The X11 model this used to depend on is gone, so only the Wayland model needed changing. The change adds an IsTransient role and a filterTransients property on TaskFilterProxyModel and TasksModel (true by default, so the task manager and pager are unchanged); when it is false, windows that are skip-taskbar only because they are transient pass the filter.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: add a filterTransients property to TasksModel

Transient windows such as dialogs were always treated as skip-taskbar,
so applets using TasksModel could never see them. Add an IsTransient
role and a filterTransients property that applets can turn off.

BUG: 405657

media.caption: Master: a TasksModel probe lists only "Editor" and itself; the "Save Changes?" dialog is missing and filterTransients does not exist.
With the patch and filterTransients: false, the "Save Changes?" dialog is in the model and marked as transient.
